TileDataHelp: Choose a Web API, RSS/Atom feed or local data file. Updates run while Start is visible. Connections and credentials are encrypted for this Windows user and excluded from exports.
TileDataSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the saved credential. Changing the server clears it unless you enter a new value.
TileDataInvalid: Check the connection: use HTTPS, loopback HTTP, or an existing local file.
HoldToCreateFolder: Hold to create or add to a folder
SelectTilesHelp: Select multiple tiles without opening apps (Ctrl+E). You can always drag tiles directly.
LayoutEditingHint: Click tiles to select; drag a selection to move it. Apps stay closed.
SelectionDoesNotFit: The selection does not fit here. Drop it on open space or move it using the group menu.
SettingsStartButton: Open ReStart when I click the Windows Start button
ErrorHotkeyInUse: Ctrl+Alt+Space is in use. Open ReStart from the notification area.
ErrorUnhandled: ReStart encountered an error and will close. Your saved layout is preserved.
SettingsShortcutHelp: Windows shortcuts such as Win+E and Win+D remain available. You can also use Ctrl+Alt+Space or the notification area.
SettingsAutostart: Start when I sign in to Windows
ErrorWindowsKeyCapture: Could not capture the Windows key:
SettingsWindowsKey: Open ReStart with a single Windows key press
ErrorInvalidUrl: Enter an http or https URL.
StatusExported: Exported. The file includes launch targets and local paths.
SettingsWallpaper: Use the desktop wallpaper as the background
SettingsLayoutHelp: Tile moves, resizing and folder edits on Start save automatically. Tile scale and group width in this settings window remain a preview until you save.
SettingsLanguageHelp: The language previews immediately. Save keeps your choice; discarding restores the previous language. App names and custom labels are preserved.
SettingsCloseOnDeactivate: Close when switching to another app
SearchHint: Type part of an app, setting or indexed filename.
ErrorFutureLayout: This layout uses a newer format and is protected from changes.
ConfirmImport: Replace your current pins? Imported tiles include launch targets. Only use files you trust.
SettingsPrivacy: No ads or usage reporting. Installed apps and shortcuts are read locally on this PC.
EmptyGroups: + Create a group and pin apps
StatusCatalogReady: {0} apps  ·  Type to search  ·  Esc to close
ConfirmDeleteGroup: Delete “{0}” and its pins? The apps themselves will remain installed.
ConfirmPower: {0} this PC? Save your work first.
ErrorLayoutRead: Could not read the layout. The original file is preserved. {0}
ErrorStartupExecutable: Use the portable ReStart.exe to register startup.
ErrorStartupPathLength: The startup path is too long. Move ReStart to a shorter path.
PreviewAutostartHelp: Preview mode does not change Windows startup registration.
StartupBackgroundHelp: Starts in the notification area when you sign in. Use the shortcut to open Start.
StatusScriptAdded: Tile added. Close settings to see it.
ScriptAuthoringHelp: Create and edit HTML, CSS and JavaScript in Tile Studio. Preview four sizes with offline sample data, then save a draft or pin the tile.
ScriptCapabilitiesHelp: Web tiles use HTML/CSS, SVG, Canvas and browser JavaScript. Direct networking needs separate permission. No Node.js, CLR or OS/filesystem bridge is exposed. Legacy native JS packages remain supported.
ErrorScriptManifestInvalid: Invalid tile manifest (version 1, title 1–80, refreshSeconds 1–3600, settings JSON ≤8192 characters).
ErrorScriptFrameInvalid: Invalid tile frame. Check text lengths, #RRGGBB colors, progress 0–1 and state JSON ≤8192 characters.
ErrorAppCommandUnavailable: This command is no longer available for this app.
ErrorAppCommand: Could not run the app command:
MigrationNone: No recorded upgrade. New settings use the current format.
MigrationReadOnly: These settings were created by a newer version and are read-only.
MigrationRollbackHelp: To roll back, exit ReStart, keep a copy of the current layout, and restore the matching backup as layout.json. An older app cannot edit a newer schema.
UpdateUpToDate: This version is up to date for the selected channel.
UpdateNoReleases: No complete release is available for this architecture and channel.
UpdateRateLimited: GitHub's request limit was reached. Try again later.
UpdateNetworkError: The update service could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
UpdateInvalidResponse: The release response could not be verified. Open Releases to check manually.
UpdateNoAutoInstall: Updates download only when you choose. ReStart verifies the package before offering restart, keeps saved settings, and restores the previous files if installation or startup fails.
UpdatePrivacy: Update checks contact api.github.com with the app version. No API key or account is required. No app list, layout or usage history is sent.
UpdatesDisabledInPreview: Network checks are disabled in preview mode.
LicenseChoose: Select a license or notice to read and copy.
SettingsStartAccentHelp: Applies to the dark Start surface. Classic colored tiles share the selected accent unless you choose an individual tile color.
ErrorInvalidColor: Enter a color as #RRGGBB, for example #0078D7.
UpdateServiceUnavailable: The public release service is unavailable. Try again later or open Releases.
ExplorerPinSetting: Show “Pin to ReStart” in File Explorer
ExplorerPinHelp: Adds one command for your Windows account. On Windows 11, choose Show more options. Turn this off before moving or deleting the portable app; launch from its new location to refresh the command.
ErrorPinPath: Choose an existing file or folder using its absolute path.
ErrorPinMissing: The selected file or folder no longer exists.
ErrorPinConnection: The running ReStart could not accept this pin. Restart ReStart and try again.
ErrorExplorerRegistration: Could not update the File Explorer command:
SystemMetricsHelp: system.metrics supplies aggregate CPU, memory, network rates, drive capacity, battery and uptime while Start is visible. It does not expose process names or arbitrary files.
SlideshowFolderSaved: Slideshow folder selected. The tile will refresh shortly.
TileLibraryHelp: Put each package folder containing manifest.json and tile.js here. Available tiles appear automatically; click one to add an independent copy.
TileLibraryEmpty: No packages yet. Copy a tile package folder into the library.
SettingsCustomColorsHelp: Color themes follow the base mode, including System. Editing either RGB field switches to custom colors, which keep their exact values. Use #RRGGBB; an empty background uses the base surface.
SearchIndexUnavailable: File search is unavailable. Check Windows indexing settings.
SettingsShowMostUsed: Show most used apps (record launches in ReStart)
AppHistoryHelp: History stays on this PC. Usage counts are recorded only when enabled. Existing apps are not marked as newly added on the first run.
SettingsJumpLists: Show recent and frequent documents in app menus
SettingsDropHints: Show drop hints and hover progress
SettingsDropGroups: Create groups by overlap (free placement only)
SettingsFreePlacementHelp: Normally, dropping into empty space creates an unnamed group. Hold Alt while dragging for independent placement, or Shift to rearrange without folders. Existing layouts are kept.
LaunchOptionsHelp: Arguments are passed to the app or shortcut. Quote paths containing spaces. Empty fields keep the Shell defaults. Windows handles administrator consent.
LaunchOptionsUnavailable: Custom launch options are available for desktop applications and application shortcuts supported by Windows.
BackgroundHelp: Your chosen image is copied into local ReStart storage. Desktop changes do not affect it. High contrast hides background images.
BackgroundInvalid: Choose a readable image file of at most 32 MiB.
ErrorDataDeleted: Local app data was deleted while ReStart was running. Restart ReStart to start fresh; the deleted layout will not be recreated from memory.
ErrorScriptSourceMissing: Tile source files are missing. Reinstall the package or replace its source in Tile Studio.
LayoutLockHelp: Locks protect positions, sizes and membership. Apps, names and colors still work. Press Ctrl+Shift+L to toggle the layout lock.
LayoutLockedStatus: Layout is locked. Unlock it to change positions, sizes or contents.
KeyboardLayoutHelp: Arrows: focus · Space: select · Ctrl+arrows: move tiles · Ctrl+Shift+arrows: move group · Alt+1–4: size · Ctrl+G: new group · Shift+F10: tile menu · Ctrl+Z/Y: undo/redo
StudioHelp: Edit HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the manifest, then preview all four fixed tile sizes. Previews use offline sample data. Save a library draft or save and pin a working tile.
StudioClickHint: Click a preview to test its click event. Sample data stays in this session. Ctrl+Enter previews; Ctrl+S saves.
StudioSaved: Saved. Library drafts and installed tiles are separate copies.
StudioDiscard: Discard unsaved changes to this tile?
StudioMissing: The original source is missing. A clock template is shown for repair. Saving replaces the missing source while keeping this tile’s position.
AllowWebTileNetwork: Allow this tile to access the network
ErrorWebTileProcess: The web tile process stopped. Reload this tile to try again.
ErrorWebTileLoad: The HTML tile could not load. Check its HTML, CSS and JavaScript in Tile Studio.
ErrorWebTileRuntime: HTML tiles require Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Install it from Microsoft, then restart ReStart.
UpdateNoticeHelp: Review what's new in ReStart, then choose whether to download the update.
StudioFormatted: Document formatted. Ctrl+Z undoes the change.
StudioFormatChanged: The document changed while formatting. Try again.
DiagnosticsHelp: Review the complete report below before sharing it. It contains versions, display mode and error categories only. No logs, names, paths, app lists, tile data or credentials are included. Nothing is uploaded.
DiagnosticsClipboardBusy: The clipboard is busy. Try again or select and copy the text.
UpdateConfirmRestart: Restart ReStart to install the verified update? Your layout and saved settings are kept.
UpdatePortableRequired: Guided updates require a complete portable package with its distribution manifest in a writable folder. Developer builds and older packages can be updated manually from GitHub.
UpdatePrepared: ReStart {0} is verified and ready. Restart when convenient.
UpdatePrepareFailed: The update could not be prepared. Your installation was not changed. Check the connection, free space and folder permissions, or use the GitHub download.
UpdateCancelled: Download cancelled. Your installation was not changed.
UpdateRepairHelp: The update could not be recovered automatically. Exit ReStart and extract the complete portable ZIP into the installation folder. Keep your local ReStart settings. Update backups remain in ReStart.UpdateCache under local app data.
UpdateRestored: The update did not finish. ReStart is running the previous installation.
SettingsBlurHelp: 0 keeps the image sharp. Blur affects only ReStart’s background image.
SettingsPreviewHelp: Appearance, tile sizing and language preview immediately. Save keeps your settings.
SettingsUnsavedBody: Your settings have unsaved changes. Save before closing, or discard to restore the previous appearance, tile sizing and language.
UpdateReadyBody: ReStart {0} is downloaded and ready to install.
UpdateReadyHelp: Restart and update to apply it. Not now keeps a reminder. An ordinary launch does not install it automatically.
DragHintReorder: Rearrange without creating or entering folders
ShortcutOpen: Open or close ReStart (Win key must be enabled)
ShortcutEscape: Close the current view, then Start
ShortcutMoveTiles: Move tiles by one small cell
ShortcutNewGroup: Create a group from the selection
PauseOffscreenLiveTiles: Pause live tiles outside the visible area
TileRecoveryPaused: This tile was paused after repeated failures. Choose Reload to retry.
BackupHelp: Includes layout, appearance, installed tiles, library drafts and background images. Connections, credentials, photo-folder paths, history and caches are excluded.
BackupPrivacy: This private backup contains app names, launch paths and your custom tile source/assets. Keep it private. Saved data connections and credentials are excluded. Continue?
BackupRestored: Backup restored. Reconfigure tile data connections and permissions as needed.
BackupConfirm: Restore {0} groups and {1} root tiles? This replaces layout and appearance. Shell integration stays local. Reconfigure data connections and web network permissions.
SettingsAppTasks: Show application tasks in app menus
WindowsAppHistoryHelp: Requires Windows app-launch tracking. Reads exact installed-app records without saving them. Clearing ReStart history does not clear Windows history.
